checks: All workflow and author-report bytes match the declared hashes.
Both exact original report hashes were independently recovered and verified from the actual failed-run logs before this review.
Exact repository/run/output identifiers, actual source/workflow identity, original failure and successful Cargo/whitespace commands are verified before reading compiler records.
The retained Cargo JSON is limited to 16 MiB, parsed without executing its contents, filtered to the exact root package and bounded to four through ten executable records.
The output reports the complete selected compiler records, exact raw Cargo-log hash and byte count in a fresh owned directory.
Only official pinned download/upload actions and embedded Python metadata parsing execute; the workflow contains no checkout, compiler, product or test command.

The sole exact-branch push trigger, hosted Ubuntu runner, read-only actions/contents permissions, five-minute timeout, seven-day result retention and later branch cleanup match the authorized diagnostic.

activation.condition: Use the reviewed byte-identical YAML on the fresh owned diagnostic branch; retain and verify actual head/run identity.

limits: This accepts only reading retained compiler output. The failed build remains failed, and any output-mapping correction requires its own static inspection and actual complete successful build.
